rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone does something in an affected or unnatural manner.

example.english: They laughed artificially twice, and everyone knew they were putting it on.
example.traditional: 佢唔自然咁笑咗兩聲，成班人都知佢扮嘢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 m4 zi6 jin4 gam2 siu3 zo2 loeng5 seng1 sing4 baan1 jan4 dou1 zi1 keoi5 baan6 je5

rows.note: Use this when something is produced or altered by a human-made method rather than naturally.

example.english: This fragrance is produced artificially, not naturally.
example.traditional: 呢啲香味係用人工方法整出嚟嘅，唔係天然㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hoeng1 mei6 hai6 jung6 jan4 gung1 fong1 faat3 zing2 ceot1 lei4 ge3 m4 hai6 tin1 jin4 gaa3
